newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-EXTRA PENALTIES FOR ENGLISH BOWLERS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-EXTRA PENALTIES FOR ENGLISH BOWLERS.

text.p: Bowlers who send down a wide will be penalised by two runs instead of one in English first-class cricket next season.
"It should help our bowlers bowl a better line," commented Test and County Cricket Board chief executive Tim Lamb.

The TCCB, to be relaunched as the English Cricket Board on January 1, have also agreed that counties requested to rest an England player before or after a test match will receive 500 pounds ($826) per day compensation.
Contracts for overseas players will also be restricted to a maximum of two years in future.
